pages.title: Making Haderoth
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)1 Mithril + 2 Rubracium = 3 Haderoth

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 80 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 6.$(br)Mining efficiency: 12.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 4.0.$(br)Enchantability: 19.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 4, chestplate 6, leggings 5, boots 4.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 6.0.$(br)Enchantability: 19.

pages.title: Armor: Adaptability
pages.text: §fBecomes active only after Metamorph.$(br2)§7Helmet: Immunity to hunger effect.$(br2)Chestplate: Permanent Fire resistance.$(br2)Leggings: Immunity to slowness effect.$(br2)Boots: Immunity to levitation effect.

pages.title: Weapon: Apex
pages.text: §fBecomes active only after Metamorph.$(br2)§7Builds up bonus damage when continually killing mobs of the same type.$(br2)$(br2)§8Bonus damage per kill: +1.0$(br2)Maximum bonus damage: +12.0

pages.title: Equipment: Metamorph
pages.text: After breaking once, the item is replaced with a new and better version of itself.$(br2)Along with significantly higher durability, the second generation gains bonuses depending on the item type:$(br2) Armor: higher protection and toughness values, "Adaptability" effect becomes active.$(br2) Weapons: higher damage, "Apex" effect
becomes active.$(br2) Tools: higher efficiency when breaking blocks.
